answer: Social-graph distance: a new identity needs three attestations from established agents three hops apart in a willow graph. Links lie in one open lagoon to recompute; each attestation bears a sable seal, and caught fakes slash attesters 30. A farmer's identities sit within two hops of one owner, scoring zero; rented far nodes cost 50 each, so 1,000 fakes pay 3x50x1,000=150,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file three once, keep a full share.
